//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the load-more component. NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses. Full block: the pa-load-more container (+ alignment modifier), the pa-load-more__button (+ --loading), and the __spinner / __text / __count elements. See ../README.md, pager.json (sibling) and button.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.align: start|center|end — justify-content of the container (core ships all three; center is also the base default)
propsVocabulary.count: count text shown in pa-load-more__count, e.g. '25 of 250' — the wrapper wraps it in parentheses
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended to the container

goldenConventions:
Goldens encode the core snippet shape (snippets/tables.html load-more):
→

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `produces` with {value}; capability.mjs expands + cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native.

align.note: center is redundant with the base justify-content:center but core ships the class; both wrappers emit it explicitly

loading.note: element-level modifier on the button; also adds the native disabled attr + the __spinner span

count.note: presence of count text renders the __count span; the class is the element that holds it

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: No JS-applied pa-load-more--* modifier; this bucket is empty. Kept for the axis-1 reverse-check contract shape.

cssStateElements.//: Empty — pa-load-more__spinner is rendered (and exercised by the `loading` golden), not a JS-runtime-only element, so nothing belongs here.

scenarios.name: with-count
